name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
description: Income support for all landholding farmer families, paid directly into their bank accounts.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year in three equal instalments of ₹2,000 through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
additional_conditions: Land must be recorded in the family's name in state land records

Excluded: institutional landholders; current or former constitutional post holders, ministers, MPs/MLAs; serving or retired government officers (except MTS / Class IV / Group D); pensioners drawing ₹10,000 or more per month; registered professionals in practice (doctors, engineers, lawyers, CAs, architects)
e-KYC and an Aadhaar-seeded bank account are mandatory
how_to_apply: Self-register on pmkisan.gov.in (New Farmer Registration), or through a Common Service Centre (CSC) or the village patwari / agriculture office, then complete e-KYC.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance (Department of Financial Services)
description: Collateral-free loans for non-farm micro and small income-generating enterprises.
benefits: Shishu: up to ₹50,000 · Kishore: ₹50,000 to ₹5 lakh · Tarun: ₹5 to 10 lakh · Tarun Plus: ₹10 to 20 lakh (for borrowers who repaid an earlier Tarun loan).
additional_conditions: For manufacturing, trading, services and allied-agriculture micro enterprises
Loan amount, interest rate and approval are decided by the lending bank / NBFC / MFI
Applicant should not be a defaulter to any bank
how_to_apply: Apply at any bank, RRB, small finance bank, NBFC or MFI branch, or online through the JanSamarth portal (jansamarth.in).

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
description: Deposit-free LPG connections for adult women from poor households, so families can cook with clean fuel.
benefits: Deposit-free LPG connection in the woman's name; targeted subsidy on refills for PMUY consumers as notified each year.
additional_conditions: Must belong to a poor household, established through a Deprivation Declaration in the prescribed format
Aadhaar of all adult family members is required; migrant families can apply with a self-declaration of address
documents: KYC application form with Deprivation Declaration
Aadhaar of applicant and adult family members
how_to_apply: Apply online at pmuy.gov.in or visit the nearest LPG distributor (Indane, Bharat Gas or HP Gas) with KYC documents.

name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
description: Single-window portal to discover and apply for central, state and UGC/AICTE scholarships.
benefits: Access to 100+ scholarships — pre-matric, post-matric, merit-cum-means and others — with payment by DBT to the student's account.
additional_conditions: Each scholarship on NSP has its own income limit, marks requirement and deadline
One-Time Registration (OTR) with Aadhaar is required before applying
how_to_apply: Create a One-Time Registration on scholarships.gov.in, then choose the scholarship you are eligible for and submit before the deadline.

name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY)
ministry: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare (National Health Authority)
description: Health assurance scheme giving eligible families cashless hospital treatment at empanelled hospitals.
benefits: Cashless treatment up to ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalisation at empanelled public and private hospitals.
additional_conditions: Eligibility comes from official databases (SECC 2011 deprivation/occupation criteria and later expansions such as AAY families and ASHA/Anganwadi workers); many states extend coverage further
Senior citizens aged 70+ are covered separately under Ayushman Vay Vandana irrespective of income
Use the official 'Am I Eligible' check to confirm
how_to_apply: Check eligibility on beneficiary.nha.gov.in or the Ayushman app, then create your Ayushman card online, at a CSC or with the Arogya Mitra at an empanelled hospital.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
description: Guaranteed pension scheme for savings-account holders, mainly aimed at workers in the unorganised sector.
benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 from age 60 depending on contribution; the same pension continues to the spouse, and the corpus goes to the nominee.
additional_conditions: Since 1 October 2022, anyone who is or has been an income-tax payer cannot join
Contributions continue until age 60 (minimum 20 years)
documents: Savings bank or post office account
how_to_apply: Enrol through your bank or post office branch, or via net banking / mobile banking; contributions are auto-debited.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
description: Crop insurance that protects farmers against crop loss from natural calamities, pests and diseases.
benefits: Low farmer premium — 2% of sum insured for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi and 5% for commercial/horticulture crops; the rest is paid by the Government.
additional_conditions: Covers notified crops in notified areas; enrol before the seasonal cut-off date
Tenant farmers and sharecroppers can enrol with the required documents
Enrolment is voluntary for all farmers, including loanee farmers
how_to_apply: Enrol on pmfby.gov.in or the Crop Insurance app, at a CSC, through your bank (for KCC/loanee farmers) or an insurance agent before the cut-off date.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maan Dhan Yojana (PM-KMY)
description: Voluntary, contributory pension scheme for small and marginal farmers.
benefits: Assured pension of ₹3,000 per month after age 60; monthly contribution of ₹55 to ₹200 is matched equally by the Government; 50% family pension to the spouse.
additional_conditions: Small and marginal farmers whose names appear in state/UT land records
Not covered under NPS, ESIC, EPFO or other statutory social-security schemes, and not enrolled in PM-SYM
how_to_apply: Enrol at a Common Service Centre (CSC) or self-enrol on maandhan.in; PM-KISAN beneficiaries can choose to pay the contribution from their PM-KISAN instalments.

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare (RKVY – Soil Health & Fertility)
description: Free soil testing with a card that shows the nutrient status of your farm and the right fertiliser dose.
benefits: Free soil test and Soil Health Card covering 12 parameters with crop-wise fertiliser recommendations, issued periodically.
additional_conditions: Farmer should have legal access to cultivable land (owned or leased)
how_to_apply: Contact the district/state soil-testing nodal officer, agriculture office or Krishi Vigyan Kendra; download the card from soilhealth.dac.gov.in or via the SMS link.

name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
description: Cheaper credit for post-harvest and community farming infrastructure such as warehouses, cold storage and processing units.
benefits: 3% per annum interest subvention for up to 7 years on loans up to ₹2 crore per project, plus credit guarantee cover.
additional_conditions: Eligible borrowers include farmers, FPOs, PACS, cooperatives, SHGs, agri-entrepreneurs and startups
Project must be an eligible post-harvest or community farming asset
how_to_apply: Apply on agriinfra.dac.gov.in with your project report; the loan is processed by a participating bank.

name: PM Vishwakarma
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises
description: End-to-end support for traditional artisans and craftspeople in 18 family-based trades.
benefits: PM Vishwakarma certificate and ID card, skill training with stipend, toolkit incentive up to ₹15,000 (e-voucher), collateral-free loans up to ₹3 lakh (₹1 lakh + ₹2 lakh) at 5% interest, and digital/marketing support.
additional_conditions: Must work with hands and tools in one of the 18 notified trades (e.g. carpenter, blacksmith, goldsmith, potter, cobbler, mason, tailor, barber, washerman, basket/mat maker) on a self-employed basis
Only one member per family (husband, wife and unmarried children)
Should not have taken similar credit (PMEGP, PM SVANidhi, Mudra) in the past 5 years unless fully repaid
how_to_apply: Register at a CSC with Aadhaar biometric authentication; verification is done by the Gram Panchayat/ULB and district committee.

name: PM SVANidhi
description: Working-capital loans for street vendors, extended and restructured till March 2030.
benefits: Collateral-free loans in three tranches of up to ₹15,000, ₹25,000 and ₹50,000; interest subsidy on timely repayment, cashback on digital transactions, and a UPI-linked RuPay credit card after repaying the second loan.
additional_conditions: Need a Certificate of Vending / ID card from the Urban Local Body or a Letter of Recommendation (LoR)
Coverage is being expanded to census towns and peri-urban areas in phases
how_to_apply: Apply online at pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in, through a CSC, a lending institution or your Urban Local Body.

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
ministry: Ministry of MSME (implemented by KVIC, KVIB and DICs)
description: Credit-linked subsidy for setting up new micro enterprises in rural and urban areas.
benefits: Margin-money subsidy of 15% to 35% of project cost (projects up to ₹50 lakh in manufacturing and ₹20 lakh in services); own contribution only 5–10%.
additional_conditions: Only for setting up NEW units, not existing businesses
Minimum Class 8 pass for projects above ₹10 lakh (manufacturing) or ₹5 lakh (services)
Higher subsidy (25% urban / 35% rural) for special categories such as SC/ST/OBC, minorities, women, ex-servicemen, PwD, transgender persons and NER/hill/border areas
No income ceiling
how_to_apply: Apply online on the KVIC PMEGP e-portal; applications are routed through KVIC/KVIB/DIC to banks for sanction.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
description: Financial assistance to houseless and kutcha-house rural families to build a pucca house (target: 4.95 crore houses by 2029).
benefits: Assistance of ₹1.20 lakh (plains) or ₹1.30 lakh (hilly/difficult areas) to build a pucca house, with convergence support for a toilet and wage employment.
additional_conditions: Beneficiaries are identified from SECC 2011 / Awaas+ survey lists and verified by the Gram Sabha

Excluded if any member earns more than ₹15,000 per month, pays income or professional tax, holds a KCC with limit of ₹50,000 or more, runs a registered non-agricultural enterprise, or owns 2.5+ acres irrigated / 5+ acres unirrigated land
how_to_apply: Names are added through the Awaas+ survey; contact your Gram Panchayat or Block office. Track status on pmayg.dord.gov.in.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0 (PMAY-U 2.0)
description: Housing for All mission for urban EWS, LIG and MIG families (implemented from September 2024 for 5 years).
benefits: Central assistance up to ₹2.5 lakh per unit to build or buy a house (BLC/AHP verticals), affordable rental housing, or an interest subsidy of up to ₹1.80 lakh on home loans (loan up to ₹25 lakh for a house up to ₹35 lakh).
additional_conditions: EWS: income up to ₹3 lakh · LIG: ₹3–6 lakh · MIG: ₹6–9 lakh — available verticals depend on your category (BLC/AHP mainly for EWS)
No family member (husband, wife, unmarried children) should own a pucca house anywhere in India
Should not have already availed housing benefits under earlier government housing schemes
documents: Affidavit of not owning a pucca house
how_to_apply: Apply on pmaymis.gov.in ('Apply for PMAY-U 2.0') or through your Urban Local Body; for the interest subsidy, apply through a participating bank or housing finance company.

name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
description: Subsidy for residential rooftop solar so households can generate their own electricity.
benefits: Central subsidy of ₹30,000 per kW for the first 2 kW and ₹18,000 for the 3rd kW (maximum ₹78,000); about 10% more in special-category states; up to 300 units of free electricity a month and collateral-free loans.
additional_conditions: Need a valid domestic electricity connection and a suitable roof
Should not have availed any other subsidy for rooftop solar
how_to_apply: Register on pmsuryaghar.gov.in with your DISCOM consumer number, choose a registered vendor, and claim the subsidy after net-meter installation and inspection.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
ministry: Ministry of Women & Child Development (Mission Shakti)
description: Maternity benefit for pregnant women and lactating mothers to support nutrition and compensate wage loss.
benefits: ₹5,000 in two instalments for the first child; ₹6,000 in one instalment if the second child is a girl (PMMVY 2.0) — paid by DBT.
additional_conditions: For the first living child, and for the second child only if it is a girl
Woman should generally be 19 years or older
Excludes women in regular employment with Central/State Government or PSUs
Aimed at women from disadvantaged sections (e.g. SC/ST, BPL/NFSA ration card, e-Shram, PwD, Ayushman Bharat, MGNREGA job card holders) as listed in PMMVY 2.0 guidelines
Register at the Anganwadi Centre / health facility; ANC check-ups and child immunisation are required for instalments
how_to_apply: Register through your Anganwadi worker or health facility, or online on the PMMVY portal (pmmvy.wcd.gov.in).

name: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
ministry: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare (National Health Mission)
description: Cash assistance to promote safe institutional deliveries, with ASHA support.
benefits: For institutional delivery: ₹1,400 (rural) / ₹1,000 (urban) in Low Performing States; ₹700 (rural) / ₹600 (urban) in High Performing States.
additional_conditions: Low Performing States (UP, Uttarakhand, Bihar, Jharkhand, MP, Chhattisgarh, Assam, Rajasthan, Odisha, J&K): all women delivering in government or accredited facilities
High Performing States: BPL/SC/ST women delivering in government or accredited facilities
how_to_apply: Register your pregnancy with the ASHA/ANM or nearest government health facility; payment is made after institutional delivery.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance (Department of Financial Services)
description: Low-cost, renewable one-year life insurance for bank and post-office account holders.
benefits: ₹2 lakh life cover (death due to any cause) for ₹436 per year, auto-debited; cover period 1 June to 31 May.
additional_conditions: Cover can be renewed up to age 55
Pro-rata premium when joining mid-year; 30-day lien period for new enrolments (except accidental death)
how_to_apply: Enrol at your bank or post office branch, via net/mobile banking, or the Jan Suraksha portal.

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance (Department of Financial Services)
description: Very low-cost accident insurance for bank and post-office account holders.
benefits: For ₹20 per year: ₹2 lakh for accidental death or total permanent disability, ₹1 lakh for partial permanent disability.
additional_conditions: Premium is auto-debited every year; cover period 1 June to 31 May
how_to_apply: Enrol at your bank or post office branch, via net/mobile banking, or the Jan Suraksha portal.

name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM)
description: Voluntary, contributory pension scheme for unorganised-sector workers.
benefits: Assured pension of ₹3,000 per month after age 60; contribution of ₹55 to ₹200 per month is matched equally by the Government; 50% family pension to the spouse.
additional_conditions: Must be an unorganised worker (e.g. street vendor, domestic worker, construction or agricultural labourer, rickshaw puller, home-based worker)
Your own monthly income must be ₹15,000 or less
Requires Aadhaar and a savings / Jan Dhan account with IFSC
documents: Savings / Jan Dhan account with IFSC
how_to_apply: Enrol at a CSC or self-enrol on maandhan.in; the first contribution is paid at enrolment, then auto-debited monthly.

name: Pradhan Mantri Samajik Sahayata Yojana (formerly NSAP)
description: Umbrella social-assistance programme for BPL households (renamed from NSAP on 14 October 2026 and continued for 2026-27 to 2030-31).
benefits: Covers old-age, widow and disability pensions, a one-time family benefit on the death of the breadwinner, and Annapurna food support; most states add their own top-up to the central amount.
additional_conditions: Household must be Below Poverty Line as per Government of India criteria
See the individual pension components for age and other conditions
how_to_apply: Apply at the Gram Panchayat / Block office (rural) or municipal office (urban), or through your state's social-security pension portal or a CSC.

name: Pradhan Mantri Vridhavastha Pension Yojana (formerly IGNOAPS)
previous_names: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
description: Monthly old-age pension for senior citizens from BPL households (renamed from IGNOAPS on 14 October 2026; benefits unchanged).
benefits: Central pension of ₹200 per month (age 60–79) and ₹500 per month (80+); states add their own share, so the amount received is usually higher.
additional_conditions: Pension is paid by DBT into a bank or post office account
how_to_apply: Apply at the Gram Panchayat / Block office (rural) or municipal office (urban), or through your state's pension portal or a CSC.

name: Pradhan Mantri Vidhawa Pension Yojana (formerly IGNWPS)
previous_names: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
description: Monthly pension for widows from BPL households (renamed from IGNWPS on 14 October 2026; benefits unchanged).
benefits: Central pension of ₹300 per month for widows aged 40–79 (₹500 from age 80), plus the state's top-up.
additional_conditions: Husband's death certificate is required
Pension is paid by DBT
how_to_apply: Apply at the Gram Panchayat / Block office (rural) or municipal office (urban), or through your state's pension portal or a CSC.

name: Pradhan Mantri Divyangjan Pension Yojana (formerly IGNDPS)
previous_names: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)
description: Monthly pension for persons with disabilities from BPL households — eligibility widened in October 2026.
benefits: Revised central pension of ₹375 per month (up to age 79) and ₹625 per month (80+), plus the state's top-up.
additional_conditions: Benchmark disability of 40% or more (earlier 80%) with a valid disability certificate / UDID; no minimum age
Revised norms were approved on 14 October 2026 and are being rolled out by states — confirm the current rate locally
how_to_apply: Apply at the Gram Panchayat / Block office (rural) or municipal office (urban), or through your state's pension portal or a CSC.

name: Pradhan Mantri Parivar Labh Yojana (formerly National Family Benefit Scheme)
description: One-time help for a BPL family after the death of its primary breadwinner (renamed from NFBS on 14 October 2026).
benefits: One-time lump-sum assistance of ₹20,000.
additional_conditions: The primary breadwinner (man or woman) must have been aged 18–59 at the time of death (natural or accidental)
Apply with the death certificate soon after the death
how_to_apply: Apply at the Gram Panchayat, Block office or municipality, or through UMANG / your state's portal.

name: Ayushman Vay Vandana (PM-JAY for Senior Citizens 70+)
ministry: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare (National Health Authority)
description: Free health cover for every senior citizen aged 70 or above, regardless of income.
benefits: Cashless treatment up to ₹5 lakh per year; seniors in families already covered by PM-JAY get an additional ₹5 lakh top-up just for themselves.
additional_conditions: Age is taken from Aadhaar; Aadhaar e-KYC is mandatory
People covered by CGHS, ECHS or CAPF schemes must choose between their existing scheme and AB PM-JAY
how_to_apply: Enrol on the Ayushman app or beneficiary.nha.gov.in, or at an empanelled hospital / CSC. Helpline: 14555.

name: PM Internship Scheme (PMIS)
description: Paid internships in top companies for young people (pilot Round 3 running in 2026).
benefits: 6–9 month internship with a stipend of ₹9,000 per month (₹8,100 from the Government by DBT + ₹900 from the company) and real work experience.
additional_conditions: Must not be in full-time employment; full-time students are eligible only in their final year (with an NOC from the institution)
Minimum qualification: Class 10 (12th, ITI, diploma and graduates also eligible)
No family member in permanent/regular government employment
Family income limit was raised to ₹12 lakh for Round 3; some premier-institute and professional-degree holders are excluded — check the latest list on the portal
how_to_apply: Register on pminternship.mca.gov.in, complete your profile and apply to internship listings.

name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana (PM-VBRY)
description: Employment-linked incentive for people starting their first formal job and for employers creating new jobs.
benefits: First-time EPFO-registered employees get one month's EPF wage, up to ₹15,000, paid in two instalments (second linked to a financial-literacy course). Employers get up to ₹3,000 per month per additional employee.
additional_conditions: Must join EPFO for the first time in a job created between 1 August 2025 and 31 July 2027
Monthly salary up to ₹1,00,000
Government employees are not covered
UAN must be activated with Aadhaar face authentication (UMANG app)
how_to_apply: No separate application: the incentive is paid by DBT through EPFO once your employer files EPF contributions and your UAN is Aadhaar-linked.

name: Viksit Bharat – Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) (VB-G RAM G)
description: Statutory rural employment guarantee that replaced MGNREGA from 1 July 2026.
benefits: Guaranteed wage employment of 125 days per financial year for every rural household whose adult members volunteer for unskilled manual work (up from 100 days under MGNREGA).
additional_conditions: The household registers with the Gram Panchayat to get a job card and then demands work
Wages are paid by DBT into bank / post office accounts
how_to_apply: Contact your Gram Panchayat to register your household and apply for work.

name: Stand-Up India
ministry: Ministry of Finance (Department of Financial Services)
description: Bank loans for women and SC/ST entrepreneurs starting a new enterprise (extended till 31 March 2031).
benefits: Composite bank loan above ₹10 lakh and up to ₹1 crore (up to 85% of project cost) for a greenfield enterprise in manufacturing, services, trading or agri-allied activities.
additional_conditions: Only for first-time (greenfield) enterprises
For companies/partnerships, at least 51% shareholding and control must be with an SC/ST or woman entrepreneur
Borrower should not be a defaulter to any bank
how_to_apply: Apply on standupmitra.in or at any scheduled commercial bank branch.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) with Interest Subvention
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / Department of Financial Services
description: Revolving short-term credit for crops, animal husbandry, dairy and fisheries at concessional interest.
benefits: Loans up to ₹3 lakh at 7% interest — effectively 4% with prompt repayment; the Union Budget 2025-26 announced raising the subvention limit to ₹5 lakh (check your bank for the current limit); collateral-free up to ₹2 lakh.
additional_conditions: Covers owner-cultivators, tenant farmers, oral lessees, sharecroppers, SHGs/JLGs, and animal-husbandry and fisheries farmers
PM-KISAN beneficiaries can apply with a simplified form
how_to_apply: Apply at any commercial bank, RRB or cooperative bank, or online through the JanSamarth portal.

name: PM Vidyalaxmi
description: Collateral-free, guarantor-free education loans for meritorious students admitted to top higher-education institutions.
benefits: Education loans without collateral or guarantor; 3% interest subvention during moratorium on loans up to ₹10 lakh for family income up to ₹8 lakh (full subvention up to ₹4.5 lakh for technical/professional courses under PM-USP CSIS); 75% credit guarantee on loans up to ₹7.5 lakh.
additional_conditions: Admission on merit to one of the designated Quality Higher Education Institutions (QHEIs) based on NIRF rankings
Interest subvention needs family income up to ₹8 lakh and no other government scholarship / interest subvention
how_to_apply: Apply on the PM-Vidyalaxmi portal — a single window to compare and apply for loans from multiple banks.

name: PM-USP Central Sector Scholarship for College and University Students
description: Merit-cum-means scholarship for students who scored above the 80th percentile in Class 12.
benefits: ₹12,000 per year for the first three years of graduation and ₹20,000 per year at PG level; about 82,000 fresh scholarships each year, half reserved for girls.
additional_conditions: Above the 80th percentile of successful candidates in your Class 12 board and stream
Must be in a regular (not distance) degree course
Must not be receiving any other scholarship or fee reimbursement
how_to_apply: Apply on the National Scholarship Portal after One-Time Registration; fresh applications usually open June–October.

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMSS)
description: Scholarship that helps bright students from low-income families continue school from Class 9 to 12.
benefits: ₹12,000 per year (₹1,000 per month) from Class 9 to Class 12 for students who clear the state NMMS test in Class 8.
additional_conditions: Must study in a government, government-aided or local-body school (students of KVs, JNVs and residential government schools are not eligible)
About 55% marks in Class 7/8 (50% for SC/ST) to sit the selection test; renewal needs the required marks each year
how_to_apply: Appear in your state's NMMS exam in Class 8, then apply / renew on the National Scholarship Portal.

name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students
description: Financial support for Scheduled Caste students studying after Class 10, up to PhD.
benefits: Reimbursement of compulsory non-refundable fees plus an academic allowance for SC students from Class 11 to PhD.
additional_conditions: Parental income limit is ₹2.5 lakh per year; a revision to ₹4.5 lakh has been proposed — check the current limit on your state portal / NSP
Implemented through state/UT scholarship portals
how_to_apply: Apply on your state's scholarship portal or the National Scholarship Portal, as notified by your state.

name: e-Shram (National Database of Unorganised Workers)
description: Free registration that gives unorganised workers a UAN e-Shram card and one-stop access to welfare schemes.
benefits: e-Shram card with a Universal Account Number (UAN), linking you to schemes such as PM-SYM pension, PMSBY accident cover and state benefits.
additional_conditions: Must be a home-based, self-employed or wage worker in the unorganised sector (including gig/platform workers and organised-sector workers not covered by EPFO/ESIC)
Need Aadhaar, an Aadhaar-linked mobile number and a bank account
how_to_apply: Self-register free at eshram.gov.in or at a CSC. Helpline: 14434.

name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)
ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution
description: Free foodgrains for families covered under the National Food Security Act (extended till December 2028).
benefits: Free foodgrains: 5 kg per person per month for Priority Household (PHH) cards and 35 kg per family per month for Antyodaya (AAY) cards; ration can be collected anywhere via One Nation One Ration Card.
additional_conditions: Must hold an NFSA ration card (AAY or PHH) issued by your state
Aadhaar seeding and e-KYC of ration-card members may be required
how_to_apply: Apply for an NFSA ration card through your state's food & civil supplies portal or office, then collect grains at any fair price shop.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0 (PMKVY 4.0)
description: Free, industry-aligned skill training and certification under the Skill India Programme.
benefits: Free NSQF-aligned short-term training (600+ new-age courses such as AI, drones, EV servicing and 5G), free assessment and certification, and Recognition of Prior Learning for experienced workers.
additional_conditions: Short-term training is generally for ages 15–45; Recognition of Prior Learning for 18–59
Must meet the eligibility of the chosen job role / course
how_to_apply: Register on the Skill India Digital Hub (skillindiadigital.gov.in) and choose a course and training centre.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
description: High-interest, tax-free savings account for a girl child's education and future.
benefits: Deposit ₹250 to ₹1.5 lakh a year for 15 years; tax-free interest and maturity (matures after 21 years); partial withdrawal for education after 18. Interest rate is notified quarterly.
additional_conditions: Account is opened by a parent / legal guardian before the girl turns 10
Maximum two accounts per family (three in case of twins/triplets)
how_to_apply: Open at any post office or authorised bank branch.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance (Department of Financial Services)
description: Zero-balance bank account for every Indian, the gateway to DBT and insurance schemes.
benefits: Zero-balance savings account with a free RuPay debit card (₹2 lakh accident cover), overdraft up to ₹10,000 for eligible account holders, and direct receipt of government benefits.
additional_conditions: Minors aged 10+ can open an account operated with a guardian
Overdraft is available after 6 months of satisfactory account operation (age 18–65)
documents: Aadhaar card or any officially valid document
how_to_apply: Visit any bank branch or Bank Mitra (business correspondent) outlet.

name: Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yojana (Madhya Pradesh)
ministry: Government of Madhya Pradesh (Women & Child Development)
description: Monthly financial support for women in Madhya Pradesh.
benefits: ₹1,500 per month by DBT (raised from ₹1,250 in November 2025).
additional_conditions: Must be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh
Family should not include an income-tax payer or a government employee/pensioner, or own a four-wheeler (except a tractor)
Aadhaar-linked, DBT-enabled bank account and Samagra ID are required
how_to_apply: Apply through camps / Gram Panchayat or ward office when registration is open; check status on cmladlibahna.mp.gov.in.

name: Mukhyamantri Kisan Kalyan Yojana (Madhya Pradesh)
ministry: Government of Madhya Pradesh (Farmer Welfare & Agriculture Development)
description: Additional state income support for PM-KISAN farmers in Madhya Pradesh.
benefits: Extra assistance paid by DBT in ₹2,000 instalments on top of PM-KISAN's ₹6,000 a year (see saara.mp.gov.in for the current annual amount).
additional_conditions: Must be an eligible PM-KISAN beneficiary and a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh
Aadhaar, bank account and land records must be verified
how_to_apply: No separate application for PM-KISAN beneficiaries; check status on saara.mp.gov.in.

name: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana (Maharashtra)
description: Monthly financial support for women in Maharashtra.
benefits: ₹1,500 per month by DBT.
additional_conditions: Permanent resident of Maharashtra — married, widowed, divorced, abandoned or destitute women, and one unmarried woman per family
No government employee or income-tax payer in the family; e-KYC is required
how_to_apply: Apply online at ladakibahin.maharashtra.gov.in or through the Anganwadi worker / ward office.
